transcript:
Speaker A: PTM mein sabki mummy teacher se sawal puch rahi thi English mein. Main chup baithi thi. Teacher ne meri taraf dekha aur bola, 'Koi question?' Maine bola, 'No, ma'am.' Beta bagal mein hi baitha tha, woh samajh gaya. Mera naam Savitri hai. Main padhi-likhi nahi hoon, par apne bete ko maine best school mein dala, English medium. Sochi thi school padha dega, par PTM mein toh mujhe hi jana hai. Teacher English mein bolti hai, 'Your child needs to improve in reading.' Mujhe samajh mein toh nahi aata, par main sar hila deti hoon. Dusri ki mummy puchti hai, 'Can you suggest some books on reading?' Mujhe bhi yahi puchna hai, par English mein kaise bolu samajh nahi aata. Report card aata hai English mein, woh marks aate hain English mein, grading system bhi English mein. A+ matlab pata hai, par 'needs to improve' ka matlab mujhe pooch ke jaanna padta hai. Ek din beta bola, 'Mummy, agli PTM mein tum mat aana, papa ko bhej do.' Maine pucha, 'Kyun?' Woh chup ho gaya. Main samajh gayi, use sharam aati hai mujhse. Us raat phone pe English Seekho app mila. Sab samjhaya tha usne. Padhna nahi hai, sirf video dekhna hai aur sunna hai. General English show khola, 'Hello se baat shuru karein' yeh pehla video tha. Aise roz ke 10 easy sentences seekhe. 'My son is in class 3. He is a good student. He needs attention in reading.' Aise chhote-chhote sentences PTM ke liye kaafi hain. Good manners ke liye English words dekha. 'Thank you, ma'am. Excuse me. I understand. Could you please explain?' Teacher ke samne bolne ke liye itna kaafi hai. AI Coach se practice ki, 24 ghante available. Bola, 'PTM hai kal, teacher se kya bolu?' AI Coach ne sikha diya. Bolo, 'Ma'am, how is my son doing in class? Is there anything I can help with at home? He sometimes finds reading difficult. Can you suggest something?' 500 baar galat bola, usne 500 baar sudhara. Yeh nahi bola ki tum padhi-likhi nahi ho, tumse nahi hoga. Agli PTM mein gayi, teacher ne pucha, 'So Mrs. Savitri, any questions?' Maine bola, 'Yes, ma'am. How is Rohit doing in English? He tries to read at home but he struggles. Can you suggest some easy books for him?' Teacher ruki, smile kiya aur boli, 'That's a great question. I'll send a list at home.' Beta paas mein baitha tha, woh meri taraf dekha, par is baar expression alag tha. Bola, 'Mummy, tum next PTM mein bhi aana.' English Seekho app download karo, General English show kholo, 'Hello se baat shuru karein' se start karo, AI Coach se practice karo. Apne bachhe ke liye seekho. Ek mahine mein PTM mein chup nahi baithoge. [In PTM, everyone's mother was asking questions to the teacher in English. I sat quietly. The teacher looked at me and asked, 'Any questions?' I said, 'No, ma'am.' My son was sitting right next to me, he understood. My name is Savitri. I am not educated, but I put my son in the best English medium school. I thought the school would teach him, but I have to go to the PTM. The teacher says in English, 'Your child needs to improve in reading.' I don't understand, but I nod my head. Another mother asks, 'Can you suggest some books on reading?' I want to ask the same, but I don't know how to say it in English. The report card is in English, the marks are in English, the grading system is also in English. I know what A+ means, but I have to ask to know what 'needs to improve' means. One day my son said, 'Mummy, don't come to the next PTM, send papa.' I asked, 'Why?' He kept quiet. I understood, he is ashamed of me. That night I found the English Seekho app on my phone. It explained everything. You don't have to read, just watch the video and listen. I opened the General English show, 'Start talking with Hello' was the first video. I learned 10 easy sentences like this every day. 'My son is in class 3. He is a good student. He needs attention in reading.' Such short sentences are enough for PTM. I looked up English words for good manners. 'Thank you, ma'am. Excuse me. I understand. Could you please explain?' This is enough to speak in front of the teacher. Practiced with AI Coach, available 24 hours. I said, 'Tomorrow is PTM, what should I say to the teacher?' AI Coach taught me. Say, 'Ma'am, how is my son doing in class? Is there anything I can help with at home? He sometimes finds reading difficult. Can you suggest something?' I said it wrong 500 times, it corrected me 500 times. It didn't say that you are uneducated, you can't do it. I went to the next PTM, the teacher asked, 'So Mrs. Savitri, any questions?' I said, 'Yes, ma'am. How is Rohit doing in English? He tries to read at home but he struggles. Can you suggest some easy books for him?' The teacher paused, smiled and said, 'That's a great question. I'll send a list at home.' My son was sitting nearby, he looked at me, but this time his expression was different. He said, 'Mummy, you come to the next PTM too.' Download the English Seekho app, open the General English show, start with 'Start talking with Hello', practice with AI Coach. Learn for your child. You won't sit quiet in PTM in a month.]

After her son asked her not to attend, she downloaded the English Seekho app and practiced daily conversations using its video lessons and AI Coach. She successfully spoke English at the next PTM, making her son proud, and urges other parents to download the app.
